v18-bon-bon.name: Bon Bon
v18-bon-bon.why: Michelin one star (held). To order: the Essence menu — a tightly edited celebration of Algarve biodiversity. Chef José Lopes (succeeding Louis Anjos in the 2026 guide). Less resort, more personal vision than Vila Joya or Ocean.

v06-vila-adentro.name: Vila Adentro
tags: Azulejo-tiled 18th-c. building on the central walled square
v06-vila-adentro.why: Azulejo-tiled 18th-c. building on the central walled square. To order: vegetable cataplana (proof the copper pot works without shellfish), octopus, prawn-curry rice. Open 10:00–22:30 daily — one of the rare all-day options inside the walls. Vegan-friendly without being only that.

v07-tert-lia-algarvia.name: Tertúlia Algarvia
tags: Traditional Algarve dishes plus cooking classes — the place to learn cataplana technique
v07-tert-lia-algarvia.why: Traditional Algarve dishes plus cooking classes — the place to learn cataplana technique. To order: seasonal menu tied to what the land and sea give that week; sign up for the class. Regional-products focus. The cooking class makes it more useful than another menu.

v10-a-do-pinto.name: A Do Pinto
v10-a-do-pinto.why: Family-run cataplana house, honest portions. To order: cataplana with shrimp and clams, grilled fish. Word-of-mouth Faro address. Not for tourists — which is exactly why you go.

v13-bago-wine-bar.name: Bago Wine Bar
tags: Faro's natural-wine reference — ~180 Portuguese references, 30–50 natural / organic / biodynamic
v13-bago-wine-bar.why: Faro's natural-wine reference — ~180 Portuguese references, 30–50 natural / organic / biodynamic. To order: by-the-glass tour of the Algarve list; tiborna open-toasts, cheese, charcuterie, fish tapas, roast black-pork sausage. 10:00-23:00, closed Sun–Mon. Live music most Fridays from 19:30. Raisin-listed.

v14-hotel-faro-rooftop.name: Hotel Faro Rooftop
tags: The best rooftop view in the city — harbour, Ria Formosa, the barrier islands
v14-hotel-faro-rooftop.why: The best rooftop view in the city — harbour, Ria Formosa, the barrier islands. To order: anything cold at sunset. Touristy but the view actually pays. Go at sunset, leave before the music.

v15-morgado-do-quint-o.name: Morgado do Quintão
tags: Family-owned since 1810; Algarve's largest certified-organic vineyard; consultant Joana Maçanita
v15-morgado-do-quint-o.why: Family-owned since 1810; Algarve's largest certified-organic vineyard; consultant Joana Maçanita. To order: monovarietal Crato Branco (the canonical Algarve white); Negra Mole rosé under the 2,000-year-old olive tree; farmers' table lunch pairing family recipes with the wines. Mon–Sat 16:00 visit slots. Won "Best Wine in Portugal – Algarve" (Revista de Vinhos) two years running. Farmstay on the estate.
v15-morgado-do-quint-o.address: Estrada das Relíquias, between Silves and Lagoa
